title: Crestline Protection Plans Paid with the Crestline Credit Card: Late-Fee Courtesy Share Addition
content:
Northgate's late-fee courtesy credit on the Crestline Credit Card recognizes Crestline protection plans paid with the card. A cardholder who holds an active Crestline road hazard certificate (Road Hazard Protection) paid with the Crestline card and an active Crestline alignment plan (Alignment Services & Plans) paid with the Crestline card adds 0.15 to the share of the late fee that the courtesy credit returns; a cardholder who holds exactly one of the two, active and paid with the Crestline card, adds 0.05; otherwise nothing is added. The share, with every addition made to it, never exceeds 1.0 — the whole fee.

## Addition table

| Road Hazard Protection certificate, active and paid with the Crestline card | Alignment Services & Plans plan, active and paid with the Crestline card | Added to the share |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 0.15 (15 percentage points) |
| yes | no | 0.05 (5 percentage points) |
| no | yes | 0.05 (5 percentage points) |
| no | no | nothing |

## Records read

- **Road Hazard Protection:** the cardholder's road hazard certificates — their status (active) and the tender used to buy them (the Crestline card).
- **Alignment Services & Plans:** the cardholder's alignment plans — their status (active) and the tender used (the Crestline card).

A certificate or plan that is not active, or that was paid with another tender (cash, another card, a fleet account), does not count.

## Cases (hypothetical)

- An active road hazard certificate paid with the Crestline card and an alignment plan paid in cash: 0.05 is added.
- Both active and both paid with the Crestline card, with the share already at 0.95 before this addition: the share is taken as 1.0, not 1.10.
